chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Hilal, from al-Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) judged regarding a woman who let herself be enabled upon by her slave, so he slept with her, that she would be whipped one hundred lashes and the slave would be whipped fifty lashes, and he would be sold for a price cheaper than her.
He (peace be upon him) said: And it is prohibited upon every Muslim that he sells to her an adult slave, after that.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib)
key_terms.فَنَكَحَهَا: He married her / had intercourse with her

ai.seo_question: What is the legal ruling when a female slave owner has sexual intercourse with her own male slave?
ai.summary: This ruling by Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), citing Ali ibn Abi Talib, establishes the legal precedent for *al-irba* (a female owner having intercourse with her male slave), distinguishing it from the more common *milk al-yamin* context. The imposition of 100 lashes on the woman and 50 on the slave reflects the specific jurisprudential view that the female owner, being free, bears a greater penalty for the act, while the subsequent sale of the slave at a reduced price (*bi-sughir*) serves as a practical mechanism to dissolve the master-slave bond permanently. The prohibition on selling another adult slave to her ensures the continuity of this specific marital-like status within the household structure.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah Bin Hilal, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding a woman who let herself be enabled upon from a slave of hers, so he slept with her, that she would be whipped one hundred lashes and the slave would be whipped fifty lashes, and he would be sold (for a price) cheaper than her’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And he<sup>asws</sup> prohibited upon every Muslim that he sells to her an adult slave, after that’.
